parsed.note_claim: Galileo Galilei first observed Saturn's "ears" in 1610, and Christiaan Huygens correctly identified its rings in 1655.
parsed.label: SUPPORTS
parsed.quote: They appeared to him as 'ears' or lobes either side of the planet. It was Christaan Huygens who first proposed that Saturn was surrounded by a solid ring in 1655.
parsed.reason: The page explicitly confirms the dates and descriptions of Galileo's and Huygens' observations cited in the note.
